l1.text: Your brain normally filters and organizes all the information coming in around you.

l2.text: After a concussion, that filtering system may not work as efficiently for a while.

l3.text: So light, sound, and other sensory information can feel much more intense.

l4.text: Sensitivity to light and sound can be a real concussion symptom.

l5.text: Understanding what's happening is an important part of understanding recovery.
